answer: To prevent a rogue actor from dominating an AI agent network with a million cheap clones, the system requires a cryptographic economic haven backed by verifiable compute rather than a simple digital fable of identity. Each agent must lock a unique staked asset, comparable in economic weight to a rare walnut, into a slashing contract. When an agent exhibits malicious Sybil behavior, network consensus automatically confiscates this collateral, imposing a prohibitive financial cost that makes mass fabrication economically irrational.
